description: Shared cross-client sync contract for the VPS push/pull protocol (Phase 12, 12C-09 / 12C-10). This file is the single source every client implementation is tested against: the VPS push handler (server/test_sync_push.mjs), the desktop agent (scripts/test-desktop-sync.mjs) and the Android queue store (core:store SyncContractFixtureTest, via the byte-identical test-resources copy). If a client and this fixture disagree, one of them is wrong; do not edit the fixture to match a client without updating the other clients.

receiptScenarios.name: explicit ack deletes only the acknowledged operation
rejected operation is retained for retry while the acked one is deleted

rules.exactOperationIds: Every pushed change carries the exact operation ID of its outbox entry (desktop: String(outbox id); Android: the queue row ID). Receipts are matched on that ID, never on the row UUID alone: several edits can share a UUID, so a UUID-only receipt cannot acknowledge any of them safely.
rules.explicitAcknowledgement: An outbox entry is deleted only when the server response explicitly lists its exact operation ID in applied[] and does not also list it in rejected[]. Missing, unknown, UUID-only and conflicting receipts all retain the entry and mark it for retry.
rules.insertOnlyLedger: The insertOnlyTables are append-only money/stock history on every client (VPS immutableLedger, desktop INSERT_ONLY_SYNC_TABLES, Android INSERT_ONLY_TABLES). A replayed row whose UUID is already stored locally is an idempotent no-op: the stored posting wins, the rest of the batch still applies, and the cursor still advances. Corrections are reversing rows, never edits.
rules.monotonicCursor: Pull cursors are non-negative integers that never move backwards within a device scope. An invalid or regressing server cursor aborts the round; the stored cursor is left unchanged.
rules.pullAtomicity: Incoming changes and the cursor advance are one atomic unit: any failure rolls back both, so a partially applied batch is never followed by a cursor that claims it arrived.
